extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Stepwise thinking — looking at a task as a chain of small ordered actions. Each part is a step. The arrangement is the sequence/order. Breaking down = cutting big task into small pieces. Example: making a sandwich — get bread, spread butter, place filling, close, cut. Order matters — cutting before spreading makes a mess. (2) Algorithms and flowcharts — algorithm = set of ordered steps that solves a problem. Flowchart = diagram showing steps using symbols. Oval = Start/End. Rectangle = Process/action. Diamond = Decision/question. Parallelogram = Input/output. Arrow = direction of flow. Pseudocode = writing steps in simple language close to code. (3) LOGO introduction — LOGO is a programming language with a turtle robot. Two parts: drawing area (where turtle moves and draws) and commander window (where you type commands). Turtle is a small triangle pointing up at start. (4) LOGO primitives — FD (Forward): move forward N steps, draws a line. BK (Backward): move backward N steps, draws a line. RT (Right Turn): turn right by N degrees, no movement. LT (Left Turn): turn left by N degrees, no movement. HT (Hide Turtle): hide the turtle arrow. ST (Show Turtle): show the turtle arrow. (5) Drawing shapes — Square: FD 100 RT 90 repeated 4 times (4 equal sides, 4 right angle turns). Rectangle: FD 100 RT 90 FD 50 RT 90 repeated twice (2 long, 2 short sides). Triangle: FD 100 RT 120 repeated 3 times (equilateral triangle, 120 degree turns). Misconceptions: 'the order of steps does not matter' (order MATTERS — making a sandwich by cutting before spreading does not work, the sequence is essential), 'FD and BK are the same' (FD moves FORWARD and BK moves BACKWARD — they go in opposite directions), 'RT moves the turtle forward and turns right' (RT only TURNS the turtle right — it does NOT move the turtle forward, the turtle stays in place), 'a square needs 3 turns' (a square has 4 sides and needs 4 turns of 90 degrees each — RT 90 four times), 'FD 100 RT 90 draws a complete square' (FD 100 RT 90 draws only ONE side and ONE turn — you must repeat it 4 times to complete the square). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function AlgorithmsLogoGame), NOT export default. Export interface AlgorithmsLogoGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
